theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_rc_tf_indicator_extension
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (h : Euclid P → ℝ), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → (∀ x ∈ U, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 h x) → (∀ y ∈ U, h y ≠ 0 → y ∈ K) → ContDiff ℝ 1 (U.indicator h) ∧ HasCompactSupport (U.indicator h) ∧ (∀ x ∈ U, fderiv ℝ (U.indicator h) x = fderiv ℝ h x) ∧ (∀ x ∉ U, fderiv ℝ (U.indicator h) x = 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
